# Quarto

> > Quarto is a global illustrated book publisher offering diverse content across cooking, art, wellness, and entertainment with multiple publishing imprints.

Quarto Group is an international publishing company with UK and US operations specializing in beautifully illustrated books across categories including culinary arts, instructional drawing guides, wellness, and puzzles. The company maintains multiple publishing imprints and actively releases new titles while promoting sustainable publishing practices.

## Key Topics

- Illustrated books
- Drawing guides
- Cooking and recipes
- Wellness and health
- Publishing imprints
- Art techniques
- Figure drawing
- Activity books
- Book catalog
- New releases
- Sustainability
- Company culture
- Global publisher
- Creative content

## Featured Titles

- [A Year of Ikigai](https://quarto.com/books/9781577155485/a-year-of-ikigai): Japanese philosophy for daily meaning and purpose by Nicholas Kemp
- [Draw Like a Mangaka: Anatomy](https://quarto.com/books/9781577157137/draw-like-a-mangaka-anatomy): Manga figure drawing anatomy guide by Marcel Kuhn
- [Drawing Class: Cats at Home and in the Wild](https://quarto.com/books/9781577156277/drawing-class-cats-at-home-and-in-the-wild): Step-by-step drawing lessons with video tutorials by Heegyum Kim
- [Cold Therapy Made Simple](https://quarto.com/books/9781577156840/cold-therapy-made-simple): Science-based guide to cold exposure by Chris Peterson
- [Bake Your Sweet Time](https://quarto.com/books/9781761501173/bake-your-sweet-time): 20 baking recipes by social media sensation Tat Effby
- [Epic BBQ Sandwiches](https://quarto.com/books/9780760398937/epic-bbq-sandwiches): Grilled and smoked sandwich recipes by Brad Prose
- [Quick Start Drawing People](https://quarto.com/books/9781577157373/quick-start-drawing-people): Tear-out pad with traceable figures by Walter Foster Creative Team
- [Mega Crosswords](https://quarto.com/books/9781577155928/mega-crosswords): 300 challenging crossword puzzles for brain training
- [Gallagher's Guitars](https://quarto.com/books/9780760398487/gallagher-s-guitars): Intimate look at Rory Gallagher's instruments by Julien Bitoun
